I'm a software engineer focused on outcomes over outputs, with a focus on automation and cloud. I use AI to modernize legacy code, stacks, and workflows, guided by implementation strategy and system design. The goal is to cut engineering effort and technical costs while building products that scale, stay maintainable, and cost less to run. Below is work I can show, with the results.

Projects

  1. Legacy App Migration to a New Stack, Built with AI

    Personal

    A legacy photo-gallery app had 3 high-severity vulnerabilities in its upload dependencies, 9 packages it used but never declared, and failed to start on a clean install. I rebuilt it on a modern stack I had never used, with Claude as a partner, but made every design decision myself. I checked each result by hand, threw out two bad performance measurements, and confirmed deletes remove both the record and the stored file. Dependency checks now find 0 vulnerabilities, a fresh clone runs locally in 16 seconds with 13 commands, and compression cut CSS from 232 KB to 49 KB.

    Angular · ASP.NET Core · Azure Cosmos DB · Blob Storage · Claude | Source Baseline

  2. Agentic Removal of a Deprecated Feature

    A deprecated feature was still live in a production codebase that was slowing teams down with routine maintenance. I ran a multi-pass AI workflow: map every dependency, verify, send each scope question to a person, then delete. It caught multiple scope corrections the first estimate missed, and it kept files that a plain pattern-match would have wrongly removed. 300+ files came out in about half a day, in a stack of pull requests that all passed CI.

    Agentic Workflows · CI/CD · Code Migration

  3. AI Agent Skill for Design-System Migration

    Team owned two dozen libraries with thousands of lines of code that had to move to the latest UI design system before the end of the quarter. We were given an AI skill that updated one library at a time. I built a wrapper skill around it that put every library on its own branch, generated a verification guide for each one, and added quality gates before review. I then handed the complex skill to an agentic workflow to run through the whole list. Per-library effort dropped from hours to near-zero, and the full set was done in about three weeks.

    Agentic Workflows · AI Agent Skills · Code Migration

  4. Multi-Ticket Lint Cleanup Pipeline

    Ran a multi-phase agentic workflow (spec, plan, implement, test, review, PR) to resolve dozens of linting violations across roughly ten interconnected projects ahead of a strict compliance deadline. Parallel implementation agents handled independently scoped work items, with independent verification so a shared-state regression never reached review. Result: a handful of clean, CI-passing PRs opened in about a day and merged the next, with every caveat disclosed.

    Agentic Workflows · Parallel Agents · CI/CD

  5. Law Firm Web Platform: Monolith to Headless

    Law firm's WordPress site was bloated, its home page graded D on GTmetrix, and it kept crashing due to hosting limits. I split the front end from the content server, put each on its own host, and set up monitoring and outage alerts on both. I also automated deploys, abd wrote a microservice for complex content delivery. With this new flexibility I was able to add email marketing and a CRM integrations, which grew a new mailing list to 40+ subscribers in the first year. The home page grade went from D to A, uptime reached 99%, and hosting costs fell about 90%, which funded the new marketing integrations.

    Digital Ocean · Next.js · Node.js · Vercel · WordPress GraphQL · MySQL · GitHub Actions · Mailchimp · HubSpot | Site

  6. Asbury Park High School Hall of Fame: Redesign & Migration

    High school Hall of Fame site wasn't mobile friendly, was hard to read and navigate, ran on plain HTTP, and was full of outdated information. Every new member bio or event photo meant hand-coding a new HTML page. I scoped it, set a three-phase plan and timeline, and rebuilt it: a mobile-responsive site with a member directory filterable by year, a donation page, an event page with printable invitation and ad forms, and past ceremony photo pages. It now runs on secure, database-backed pages with accessibility and basic SEO covered. Updates no longer need a hand-coded page: they email me content and images, I add them, and hosting dropped from paid to free.

    Next.js · MongoDB · ADA · SEO

  7. Unleashed Potential: Headless CMS Rebuild

    Defined the roadmap and timeline for a site redesign, then built it on a headless CMS with sections for podcasts, interviews, blog posts, and YouTube videos, so the owner could publish her own marketing content. Set the keyword and technical SEO strategy and set up analytics and search indexing. Rebuilding on free-tier hosting eliminated her $20-a-month Wix cost, leaving only an $8-a-year domain.

    Next.js · TypeScript · Contentful · SEO

  8. CubbieKit: Shipping Label Automation

    Designed the backend solution to a shipping label problem for a Shopify store and owned it as lead engineer, tracking work in Linear with twice-weekly standups. Built a Node.js server that queries Shopify through GraphQL and creates labels through Shippo, deployed it to Heroku, and tested it against the live store. Worked with customer service to automate return labels using sample orders.

    Node.js · Shopify GraphQL · Shippo · Heroku
